data.body: Comment-state enrichment perf fix landed on autofix-chunk12-20260603 in commit 1b621b3877 (parent-sync fixes in 771dd2e2ef). The live comment fetch previously issued one acli comment list call per commented ticket every pass (~1-2s each, fleet-wide). New AcliClient.get_comment_map(project) issues ONE paged POST /rest/api/3/search/jql with fields=[comment]; fetch_snapshot merges the returned comment field into each snapshot entry so outbound_differ._diff_comments dedups via the snapshot-carried path without a per-ticket round-trip. Per-ticket get_comments fallback kept ONLY for entries the search omits (keys without a comment field are left without a comment key); the never-emit-blind invariant stays intact. get_comment_map mirrors get_parent_map degradation: HTTP 410 -> ERROR (endpoint retirement loud), other faults -> WARNING + empty map -> per-ticket fallback; on any enrichment failure the snapshot is still written and every ticket falls back. Reconciler suite 788 passed / 1 pre-existing failure (test_e2e_dedup_pass) / 2 xfail. Ticket left OPEN pending live re-probe validation.
